title: sdks: unify auth/retries, streaming ergonomics, parity fixes + version bump v1.147.0
author: Aisha Raman
description: Motivation: We maintain three SDKs (Python / TypeScript / Go) and have drift in auth/retry behavior, streaming ergonomics, and small API surface differences that confuse integrators and complicate support. This PR unifies the surface and behavior across SDKs to match the platform contract (auth token refresh + consistent retry semantics + streaming API ergonomics) and bumps the SDK versions to v1.147.0. Summary of changes: 1) Auth & retries: introduce a shared retry policy for transient auth errors (401/403 on token expiry) with centralized token refresh hooks. Python/TS/Go now expose identical extension points for custom token providers and a default exponential-backoff retry with jitter for idempotent calls. 2) Streaming ergonomics: normalize streaming client APIs so that streaming responses for chat/generate expose the same iterator/async iterator shape across languages and add optional progress callbacks. 3) Parity fixes: align parameter names (e.g., stop_sequences -> stop, max_new_tokens -> max_tokens) and normalize error codes returned by the SDK wrappers. 4) Version bumps: package versions bumped to v1.147.0, changelogs updated. Non-goals: no model-serving runtime changes. Testing & CI: added integration tests that exercise auth refresh during streaming, retry behavior under intermittent 5xx/401s, and TS/Go parity test harness. All CI jobs were fixed/re-ran after an initial TS flaky test failure. Migration notes: - Existing embedded token providers continue to work; custom implementations should implement the new token provider interface (small shim provided in the release notes). - Streaming callers: minor rename compatibility layer added for stop_sequences and max_new_tokens; consumers can opt into the new names immediately or rely on the shim for one release. Checklist: - [x] Python: unify auth flow, add retry middleware, update streaming client - [x] TypeScript: streaming ergonomic surface, fix parity tests - [x] Go: token provider interface, parity fixes, bump go.mod - [x] Docs: SDK migration notes + examples - [x] Changelog updates - [x] CI: integration tests for token refresh and retries Backports: plan to backport minimal auth retry fix to 1.146.x if customers report regressions (tracked ENG-3302). Related: Linear ENG-3241 (SDK parity), ENG-3280 (streaming ergonomics).

notes_for_support: If customers report unexpected 401s after the upgrade, ask for SDK version, token provider implementation, and attach logs; token refresh flow now retries once on 401 before surface error and exposes hook for custom refresh. Tracked in SUP-4422.
